alignments.note: Cognate infinitive absolute; the ASV spends *Be ... diligent* on its emphasis, which is this morpheme's own rendering under rule 56, headed on the word carrying the emphasis.
The finite cognate verb keeps its subject and its lexical verb with the infinitive marker (rules 17, 52); unit interleaved with the infinitive absolute under rule 25.
Construct noun recast as *the state*, with the supplied *the* joining it under rule 15.
Rectum takes the *of* (rule 19); discontinuous around the possessive.
Italic *And*: the second colon writes no conjunction morpheme, so no morpheme licenses the coordinator (rule 14).

שִׁית לֵב is rendered *look well*, in which no English word writes either morpheme's own lexeme; the phrase is indivisible, so rule 6's fallback anchors the source head on the first token and the target head on the lexical English anchor. Competing reading: splitting *look* onto שִׁית and marking לֵב unrepresented.
The ASV recasts this suffix's possessive onto the noun standing beside it; the suffix is the morpheme the determiner realizes (rules 18, 41).

review_notes: Competing reading for t001/t003: reading *Be thou* as the finite verb's frame and giving only *diligent* to the infinitive absolute; taken as above because rule 56 gives the infinitive absolute whatever the ASV spends on its emphasis and rule 17 leaves the finite verb its own subject, which the ASV writes as the *thou* of *Be thou*.
The supplied *thy* of *thy herds* is placed on the suffix of לִבְּךָ rather than marked added, since a possessive morpheme stands in the clause for it (rule 41's closing sentences).
